Quality Systems Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Coordinator - Data Analyst Co-Op

Posting Start Date: 9/16/26

Job Location(s): Ottawa

Requisition ID:78438

If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high-performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. Through our broad technology expertise and one of the most extensive product portfolios in the industry, we are Connecting Everyone and Everything, All the Time.

At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management, and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creative thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together are changing the way the world communicates.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Job Overview

Are you looking to transition from theory to a tangible hands-on co‐op? Look no further and apply for Skyworks co‐op role!

We are looking for self‐motivated individuals, with a desire to learn. In this position, a mentor will guide you and provide the foundational knowledge needed to shift from a classroom environment to hands‐on application. This co‐op role will work on‐site from January – December 2027.

Benefits: In this full‐time role, the candidate will have exposure to multiple groups in the organization such as but not limited to quality, engineering, management, information technology, etc. This role is part of the Production Part Approval Process team, which helps to support automotive products moving to production. The PPAP Coordinator is responsible for the PPAP process for the assigned business units, supports part approvals in official PPAP format and with documented results.

Responsibilities

• Understand and apply the PPAP 18 document elements that are the requirements of the AIAG PPAP 4th edition standard.
• Provide support to other teams and departments within the company (automotive business units, sales teams, and manufacturing teams) to complete and compile PPAPs and Part Submission Warrants (PSWs), elevate when help is needed.
• Assist PPAP coordination meetings with assigned business units and keep current on status of all PPAP.
• Manage updates to the PPAPs: • Triggered by product changes or customer requests (Support customer driven PPAP changes, updates, and/or questions)
• Ensure status updates to the customer contacts of pending PPAP changes and PPAP submissions.
• Manage time to keep deadline with approved PPAPs by collaborating with cross‐functional teams including quality, engineering, and production to complete PPAP submissions in a timely manner.

• Support Engineering groups and customer support teams with PPAP creations and/or updates.
• Understand the requirements of the IMDS (International Material Declaration System) entry and collaborate with Skyworks Products team in obtaining the IMDS data for the PPAP document.
Required Experience and Skills
• Excellent computer skills with proficiency in formatting, styles and fields
• Microsoft 365 Apps, SharePoint
• Strong organizational/prioritization skills
• Good analytical/problem solving skills.
• Ability to effectively work with multiple communication tools.
• Highly motivated, self‐starter
• Ability to work independently and closely with all teams.
• Manage multiple responsibilities/tasks simultaneously.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills with a keen sense of customer service
Desired Experience and Skills
We are looking for a candidate who is attending a Graduate degree in Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or related field. They should also have knowledge using the following software/tools:

• Knowledge in relational SQL and No SQL databases.
• Knowledge on Power BI for building interactive dashboards and publishing via MS Teams.
• Knowledge in Salesforce platform (e.g., reports, dashboard creation)
The typical pay range for an intern is currently CAD $25.00 - $44.00 per hour. Starting base pay will depend on level of education and the ultimate job duties and requirements.

job_description:
Division:  IGM Technology

Location:  Toronto, Winnipeg

IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025. It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

Founded in 1926, IG Wealth Management is a key part of IGM's business model, providing comprehensive wealth management services to Canadian financial advisors and their clients.

With a vision to inspire financial confidence, IG Wealth Management is recognized as one of Manitoba’s Top Employers, Canada’s Top 100 Employers, and Best Diversity Employers, aiming to innovate the industry and support Canadians in achieving their financial goals.

Join our team to engage in continuous learning and skill development in a supportive environment. Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work environment, where you spend three days a week in the office, connecting, collaborating, and enjoying quality time with your amazing colleagues! Our Values: Be better; we strive for improvement in everything we do. Be accountable; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly. Be a team; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals.

Role & Responsibilities

The Business Systems Analyst, Technology Risk is part of the First Line of Defence and supports effective delivery and continuous improvement of technology risk processes, systems, data, and reporting. The role works with Technology Risk, Cybersecurity, Technology, and business stakeholders to understand needs, translate them into clear business and system requirements, and support the implementation of practical solutions. Reporting to the AVP, Technology Risk, the analyst will help strengthen risk governance, improve data quality and workflow efficiency, and enable timely, decision-useful risk insights.

Key Responsibilities

Business Analysis & Solution Delivery

• Engage stakeholders to understand business needs, pain points, risks, and desired outcomes for Technology Risk processes and tools.
• Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business, functional, data, reporting, and integration requirements.
• Translate business needs into user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria, data definitions, and solution requirements.
• Assess current-state processes and recommend practical improvements that strengthen controls, reduce manual effort, and improve the user experience.
• Support solution design, configuration, implementation, and adoption in partnership with product owners, technology teams, vendors, and risk stakeholders.

Technology Risk Processes, Data & Reporting

• Support technology risk processes, including risk assessments, control assessments, issue and action tracking, risk acceptance and exceptions, key risk indicators, and regulatory or audit activities.
• Maintain process documentation, data dictionaries, business rules, standard operating procedures, templates, and traceability between requirements and delivered solutions.
• Analyze technology risk data to identify trends, gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities to improve data quality and reporting.
• Develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and management reports that translate technology risk information into clear business insights.
• Help ensure processes and solutions align with enterprise policies, standards, risk frameworks, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Testing, Change & Stakeholder Support

• Develop test plans and test cases, coordinate user acceptance testing, document results, and support defect triage and resolution.
• Facilitate workshops, interviews, and working sessions to build consensus, resolve requirement gaps, and support informed decisions.
• Communicate requirements, process changes, delivery status, risks, dependencies, and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Support change impact assessments, training materials, user guidance, implementation readiness, and post-implementation reviews.
• Build trusted relationships across Technology Risk, Cybersecurity, Technology, Internal Audit, Compliance, and business teams.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, computer science, engineering, risk management, or a related field.
• 3–5 years of experience in business systems analysis, technology risk, cybersecurity, governance, risk and compliance, or a related discipline; experience in financial services is preferred.
• Demonstrated experience eliciting and documenting requirements, mapping processes, defining user stories and acceptance criteria, and supporting solution delivery.
• Experience supporting GRC, risk, audit, compliance, workflow, or reporting platforms and working with structured risk and control data.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to reconcile data, identify root causes, and convert findings into practical recommendations.
• Experience with reporting and analysis tools such as Excel and Power BI; familiarity with SQL, data visualization, or system integrations is an asset.
• Working knowledge of technology risk and cybersecurity concepts and relevant frameworks and standards, such as NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT, and CIS Controls.
• Relevant certifications such as CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, CRISC, CISA, CISM, or equivalent are considered an asset.

Core Competencies

• Analytical and Detail-Oriented: Evaluates complex processes and data, identifies gaps, and produces accurate, well-structured deliverables.
• Stakeholder-Focused: Builds effective relationships, facilitates productive discussions, and balances different perspectives.
• Clear Communicator: Translates business, technology, and risk concepts into concise requirements, documentation, and decision-ready insights.
• Delivery-Oriented: Takes ownership, manages dependencies, and follows work through from discovery to implementation and stabilization.
• Continuous Improvement Mindset: Looks for practical opportunities to simplify processes, strengthen controls, and improve data and user outcomes.

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $64,000 - $85,000 which is determined based on skills, knowledge and experience and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for annual short-term incentive, health and well-being benefits, retirement and savings plan, paid time off and career development.

Benefits

• COMPETITIVE COMPENSATION & RECOGNITION: competitive base salary, performance-weighted bonus, education/career support, option to join Employee Share Purchase Plan with employer matching component.
• EMPLOYEE BENEFITS & INSURANCE: competitive health and dental coverage, flexible plan for you and your family and short-term & long-term disability plans.
• RETIREMENT SAVINGS PROGRAMS: voluntary Defined Contribution Pension Plan
• WORK LIFE BALANCE: paid volunteer days, competitive time off, including 10 wellness days off, WorkPerks discount program, hybrid & flex work arrangements.
• INCLUSIVE CULTURE AND DIVERSITY: living our core values: Be a Team, Be Accountable, Be Better, engaging with community through Business Resource Groups (BRG communities are volunteer employee-led groups formed around a common interest, identity, or background).

IGM is a diverse workplace committed to doing business inclusively - this starts with having a representative workforce! We encourage applications from all qualified candidates that represent the diversity present across Canada – including racialized persons, women, Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, 2SLGBTQIA+ community, gender diverse and neurodiverse individuals, as well as all who may contribute to the further diversification of ideas.

IG is an accessible employer committed to providing a barrier- free recruitment experience. If you require an accommodation or this information in an alternate format at any stage of the recruitment process, please reach out to the Talent Acquisition team who will work with you to meet your needs.

Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment: As part of our Talent Acquisition process, we may use artificial intelligence and automated tools to support activities such as candidate sourcing, application review, and interview scheduling. These tools support the recruitment process; all hiring decisions are made by people.

How to Apply: Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter detailing their qualifications and experience to https://www.ig.ca/en/careers

We thank all applicants for their interest in IG Wealth Management; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Please apply before November 2 2026.

Junior Data Scientists, Quantitative Analysts & Machine Learning Researchers. Remote AI Project

We are seeking experienced Data Scientists, Quantitative Analysts, Machine Learning Researchers, and Statistical Modeling Professionals to contribute to a remote AI project focused on statistics, machine learning, experimentation, and quantitative reasoning.

You will evaluate AI-generated solutions to technical and quantitative problems, identify flawed methodology, create challenging prompts and datasets, develop reference solutions, and provide structured feedback that improves model performance.

What You’ll Do

• Evaluate AI-generated responses across data science, statistics, machine learning, experimentation, and quantitative analysis.
• Identify incorrect assumptions, statistical errors, flawed methodology, weak experimental design, and unsupported conclusions.
• Create challenging expert-level prompts based on realistic analytical and quantitative problems.
• Build or review datasets used to evaluate model performance.
• Develop reference solutions that demonstrate correct methodology and reasoning.
• Assess whether analytical approaches are statistically sound, reproducible, and appropriate for the problem.
• Review model reasoning related to experimentation, causal inference, forecasting, predictive modeling, and data interpretation.
• Evaluate code and analytical workflows when relevant.
• Provide structured technical feedback explaining why an approach is correct or incorrect.
• Help refine evaluation criteria and improve the difficulty and quality of quantitative tasks.

Who Can Apply

Relevant backgrounds include Data Scientists, Senior Data Analysts, Junior Data Scientists, Associate Data Scientists, Quantitative Analysts, Quantitative Researchers, and Applied Scientists.
We also welcome Machine Learning Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Research Scientists, and Applied Machine Learning Researchers with strong quantitative foundations.

Statistics backgrounds may include Statisticians, Applied Statisticians, Biostatisticians, Statistical Analysts, and Statistical Modeling Specialists.

Experimentation backgrounds may include Experimentation Scientists, Product Data Scientists, Decision Scientists, Causal Inference Specialists, and A/B Testing Experts.

Finance backgrounds may include Quantitative Researchers, Quantitative Strategists, Financial Data Scientists, Risk Modelers, and Quantitative Finance Professionals.

Additional relevant backgrounds include Econometricians, Operations Research Scientists, Analytics Scientists, Research Analysts, and Computational Researchers with strong statistical expertise.

Requirements

• At least one year of professional experience in data science, quantitative analysis, statistics, machine learning, finance, research, or a closely related field.
• At least part of that experience must have occurred within the past three years.
• Strong foundation in statistics, probability, and quantitative reasoning.
• Experience analyzing real-world datasets and interpreting results.
• Ability to identify flawed methodology and statistical errors.
• Strong understanding of experimentation or model evaluation principles.
• Working knowledge of Python, R, SQL, or comparable quantitative tools.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to communicate technical and statistical concepts clearly in writing.
• Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Background

• Professional experience at a leading technology company, financial institution, research organization, or quantitatively rigorous company.
• Experience in product data science, experimentation, quantitative research, applied machine learning, statistics, or analytics.
• Experience designing or reviewing A/B tests, predictive models, or quantitative research.
• Experience with causal inference, forecasting, recommendation systems, risk modeling, or optimization is valuable.
• Experience reviewing technical analyses, research reports, or model outputs for methodological quality.
• Experience creating technical assessments, analytical case studies, interview problems, or quantitative benchmarks is helpful.

This opportunity is ideal for quantitative professionals who can look at a statistical or machine learning problem, identify whether the methodology is genuinely sound, catch subtle errors in assumptions or evaluation, build a rigorous reference solution, and clearly explain why one analytical approach is stronger than another.
